ops.title: 0.27.x breaking state-schema hard-cut: no migration from flat v0 state; cask upgrade kills the resident helper
ops.description:
Found live on yasyf-home 2026-07-26: upgrading the cask 0.17.0→0.27.3 made every cookiesync invocation fail with 'parse state ~/.config/cookiesync/state.json: state.json schema mismatch; manually recreate exact schema v1 state: envelope: keys do not exactly match [schema host_registry cookie_sync]'. The 0.17.0-era state is flat {browsers, consent_route_hard, consent_route_to, row_baselines, self_target}; 0.27.x demands the synckit hostregistry envelope. No migration code, no changelog notice — the 4th/5th no-migration hard-cut of the Jul-17-26 incident (synckit 73170ef pattern; reposync identical). Compounding: 'brew upgrade --cask cookiesync' purges the running version's Caskroom dir, hard-killing the resident helper (PID 1800 died at upgrade, then KeepAlive crash-looped every 10s on the new binary's parse failure).

RECOVERED via lossless envelope wrap, verified against the real 0.27.3 binary before touching live state: {schema:{identity:'cookie-sync-state-v1', version:1, fingerprint:d4b4bb3d73830e06873742ec4e67f28d2f98fd55aaefc01ee83690a1458b8a8a}, host_registry:{self:'',hosts:[]}, cookie_sync:<flat payload + explicit DefaultSettings 15m/5m/3s/1h>}. self_target stays IN the product payload (state.go:38); settings needs explicit defaults (settingsFromJSON applies none — settings.go:96-113); tombstoned registry entries preserved (load-bearing for CRDT merge). Full recipe + citations in the daemonkit incident log 68c576df; artifacts in ~/cookiesync-migration-20260726/ on yasyf-home. Post-migration: doctor 7/7, keyless helper live, 15-min window stable.

ops.text: A 0.17-era flat state.json is migrated automatically on upgrade (or a documented migrate verb exists); the error no longer says 'manually recreate' with no tooling
The upgrade path does not kill the resident helper (bootout-first upgrade documented, or the helper Program survives Caskroom purge via staging)
